**­­Overview:**
 We are seeking a
 **Postdoctoral Research Associate** 
 who will focus on the development, application, and optimization of an active learning workflow for dataset generation of atomic structures and training of machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) in a way that maximizes the capability of high\-performance computing (HPC) platforms available in the Oak Ridge Leadership Computing Facility (OLCF). This position resides in the Advanced Computing for Chemistry and Materials Group in the National Center for Computational Sciences (NCCS), Computing and Computational Sciences Directorate (CCSD), at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL).
   

  

**Major Duties/Responsibilities:**
* Develop, implement, and apply machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) for molecular dynamics simulations.
* Develop and optimize automated workflows for data generation and active learning, including molecular dynamics (MD) sampling, configuration selection, labeling with reference methods, and model training.
* Implement and optimize large\-scale MD simulations using MLIPs and other atomistic models on HPC resources.
* Evaluate, integrate, and optimize different MLIP architectures and implementations, including pretrained universal models and models tailored to specific chemical and materials systems.
* Develop, debug, profile, and optimize scientific codes and workflows on massively parallel computing systems, including GPU\-accelerated platforms.
* Develop and maintain scientific software, primarily in Python, using modern practices for software development, testing, documentation, and version control.
* Work with tools and libraries for atomistic simulation and machine learning, such as LAMMPS, ASE, PyTorch, and related tools.
* Develop and evaluate strategies to improve the performance, scalability, efficiency, and robustness of MD simulations, MLIP inference, data generation, and model training.
* Collaborate with computational scientists, HPC specialists, software developers, and researchers across scientific domains to develop and apply new computational methods.
* Conduct collaborative research, analyze and communicate scientific results, and contribute to peer\-reviewed journal articles, conference papers and presentations, and technical documentation.
* Deliver ORNL’s mission by aligning behaviors, priorities, and interactions with our core values of Impact, Integrity, Teamwork, Safety, and Service. Promote equal opportunity by fostering a respectful workplace – in how we treat one another, work together, and measure success.


**Basic Qualifications:**
* A Ph.D. in Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related discipline, completed within the last five years.
* Experience with molecular dynamics (MD) simulations.
* Experience with machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) or atomistic machine learning methods applied to chemistry, physics, or materials science.
* Experience with Python and scientific software development.
* Knowledge of fundamental machine learning concepts, including the training, validation, and application of neural network models.
* Experience with Linux\-based scientific computing environments for HPC.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Significant experience developing, training, fine\-tuning, or applying MLIPs, including graph neural network\-based models, equivariant models, or pretrained universal potentials.
* Experience with MLIP frameworks such as HIP\-NN, MACE, NequIP, Allegro, ANI, and UMA.
* Experience with atomistic simulation software such as LAMMPS, ASE, GROMACS, OpenMM, TorchSim, or related MD simulation packages.
* Experience with MLIP\-based molecular dynamics, including system preparation, simulation execution, trajectory analysis, and evaluation of model stability and accuracy.
* Experience with active learning, uncertainty quantification, configuration selection, automated dataset generation, or related methodologies.
* Experience developing and managing automated and parallel scientific workflows, including task execution systems, dependency management, and pipeline execution on distributed computing resources.
* Experience with HPC systems, including running and managing applications on multi\-node, GPU\-accelerated systems.
* Experience with HPC resource and workload management systems such as Slurm, using workflow methodologies and/or tools such as Parallel, Flux or Parsl.
* Familiarity with concepts of parallelism, scalability, and efficient utilization of computational resources.
* Experience with GPU accelerators and computing ecosystems such as CUDA and/or AMD ROCm/HIP.
* Experience with performance profiling and optimization of scientific applications, particularly molecular dynamics and machine learning applications.
* Familiarity with electronic structure and quantum chemistry methods, such as density functional theory (DFT), and their use in generating reference data for MLIPs.
* Experience with modern scientific software engineering practices, including Git, automated testing, software environments, continuous integration, documentation, and collaborative development.
* Familiarity with parallelization and high\-performance programming techniques such as MPI, OpenMP, multiprocessing, or distributed computing in Python.
* Track record of publishing research results in peer\-reviewed scientific journals and presenting research at scientific conferences.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Motivated self\-starter with the ability to work independently and to participate creatively in collaborative teams across the laboratory.
* Ability to function well in a fast\-paced research environment, set priorities to accomplish multiple tasks within deadlines, and adapt to ever changing needs.

**Job Description:**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Applied Data Scientist to join our team. In this role, you will design, build, evaluate, and deploy ML, LLM, and agentic capabilities that improve real\-world cybersecurity detection, investigation, and response workflows.
   

  

 You will work closely with data engineers, software engineers, security researchers, and threat analysts to turn complex security data and attack scenarios into reliable, scalable, and measurable AI\-powered product capabilities. This is a hands\-on applied role focused on solving practical cybersecurity problems using data science, machine learning, LLMs, agents, and modern AI systems.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Apply machine learning, statistical analysis, LLMs, and agent\-assisted techniques to solve practical cybersecurity problems across detection, triage, investigation, and response.
* Analyze large, complex security datasets to identify behavioral patterns, anomalies, attack signals, and trends that can improve threat detection and analyst workflows.
* Translate real\-world cybersecurity use cases into data science problems, including problem framing, dataset creation, feature development, model selection, evaluation, and iteration.
* Design, develop, and evaluate ML and LLM powered security workflows, including retrieval, reasoning, tool use, human\-in\-the\-loop review, feedback loops, and guardrails.
* Build evaluation frameworks, metrics, benchmarks, and test datasets to measure model quality, reliability, precision, recall, latency, robustness, and operational impact.
* Develop prompts, instructions, retrieval strategies, and model interaction patterns that improve the usefulness, consistency, and safety of LLM\-powered features.
* Partner with software engineers to productionize models, AI agents, and data pipelines in secure, scalable, and maintainable systems.
* Monitor deployed models and workflows for performance drift, data quality issues, false positives, false negatives, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with cybersecurity researchers, threat analysts, and product stakeholders to ensure AI capabilities address real user needs and evolving threat scenarios.
* Translate relevant advances in ML, LLMs, agentic AI, and cybersecurity into practical product improvements, evaluation methods, and internal best practices.


**Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field. A master’s degree is a plus.
* Strong hands\-on foundation in machine learning, applied statistics, and data science, including supervised learning, unsupervised learning, anomaly detection, model evaluation, and experimentation.
* 3\+ years of experience applying data science or machine learning in production or applied settings. Experience in cybersecurity, fraud, risk, abuse, observability, or other adversarial or high\-noise domains is strongly preferred.
* Proficiency in Python and common data science/ML libraries. Experience with PySpark, Databricks, SQL, or large\-scale data processing frameworks is a plus.
* Experience working with LLMs in applied or production contexts, including prompt engineering, model selection, evaluation, retrieval\-augmented generation, and safe deployment.
* Familiarity with embeddings, vector databases, retrieval systems, and RAG\-based workflows for security, knowledge\-intensive, or analyst\-facing applications.
* Understanding of AI and LLM security considerations, including adversarial inputs, prompt injection, data privacy, model misuse, governance, and safe system design.
* Experience partnering with engineering teams to deploy, monitor, and improve ML models, AI workflows, or data products in production environments.
* Ability to reason under uncertainty, work with noisy and incomplete data, and make pragmatic tradeoffs between model performance, explainability, latency, reliability, and operational value.
* Demonstrated ability to independently frame ambiguous problems, develop, and validate solutions, and drive them from experimentation through production and measurable impact.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across security, engineering, data, product, and research teams.

**About Us**
 Higharc is a VC\-backed startup that is changing how new homes are designed and built. Join a founding team who’ve shipped products for Autodesk, Electronic Arts, Nike, and Apple. We have raised over $175M with support from top\-notch venture capital firms and more than 18 strategic investors: industry leaders in construction, building products manufacturing, and distribution.
   

  

 Higharc is seeking a
 **Staff Software Engineer** 
 to lead the technical architecture and delivery of our Home Design Experience application, a browser\-based 3D tool that lets anyone design a home. You’ll report to the VP of Engineering and serve as the primary technical partner to the team’s product/UX lead.
   

  

 As the HDE team’s most experienced engineer, you’ll make consequential technical decisions, write production code, and help other engineers deliver. Your immediate focus will be getting the application into customers’ hands. Along the way, you’ll partner with our platform team to establish shared foundations and patterns that other Higharc applications can reuse.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 You’ll need to move fast, make good calls under ambiguity, and turn rough product ideas into working software that customers can pick up and use without a manual. You'll work across the primary UI as well as AI\-supported and agentic experiences, and you'll partner with the other staff\-level engineers at Higharc to give the company's technical strategy real shape.
   

  

*Expect to:*
* Rapidly prototype new home design workflows and turn the ones that land into customer\-ready software
* Lead development of interactive 3D home design workflows, connecting the application UI, design data, and real\-time 3D scene into a responsive experience. Build AI\-supported and agentic interactions that help users design their homes.
* Own application architecture and technical delivery from early prototypes through production. Make decisions across the frontend, application state, and service integration, including performance, reliability, and testing.
* Be an independent technical partner to the product/UX lead: challenge assumptions, identify risks early, propose alternatives, and help decide what to build next.
* Turn ambiguous goals into concrete implementation plans, resolve technical unknowns through working code, and implement the critical pieces yourself to keep delivery moving.
* Partner with the platform team to use and improve shared application foundations. Identify which patterns should be reused across Higharc and help implement and document them, keeping immediate product delivery central to those decisions.
* Help less experienced engineers take ownership through pairing, code review, and clear technical guidance. Establish patterns they can confidently extend.


**About You**
 You've shipped products that solve genuinely hard problems in a way that feels effortless to the end user, and you know how much unglamorous work sits behind that kind of simplicity. You're comfortable being the most senior engineer in the room without needing everything decided before you start building, and you know how to narrow scope, ship useful increments, and make technical decisions that support continued delivery.
   

  

*You have:*
* A track record of personally architecting, building, and shipping substantial web applications, with responsibility for technical decisions from initial implementation through production use.
* Deep hands\-on experience with TypeScript, React, and modern web application architecture, including application state, API integration, performance, and maintainability.
* A strong plus: hands\-on experience with Three.js and browser\-based 3D applications, especially design or CAD tools. You’ll be helping people design homes in 3D, so experience making complex spatial interactions intuitive is particularly valuable.
* Genuine enthusiasm for AI\-forward development and for building AI\-supported or agentic product experiences
* Experience making technical decisions independently in partnership with a product or design lead. You can explain tradeoffs, challenge a proposed approach constructively, and commit to a path forward.
* Sound judgment about what to build for the immediate product and what to generalize for reuse, with experience collaborating across application and platform teams.
* Experience helping less experienced engineers deliver through implementation, mentoring, and technical guidance.
* A growth mindset and real ease with ambiguity, on a team and product area that's still being defined
* Strong instincts for design and craft, even though you're not the designer on the team


 Working at Higharc

 Our company is entirely remote, and has been since we were founded in 2018\. Remote work means more time with family, less time commuting, and the flexibility to blend work and life. We value in\-person collaboration
 ***and***
 asynchronous deep\-work time, which is why we schedule regular team meet\-ups in our hubs across the US and, depending on the role, prioritize hiring in those hubs.  Higharc offers competitive salaries with significant equity, in a fast\-growing, well\-funded company.
